knowledge_gaps: The isolated runner remains unspecified: callable interface, artifact manifest, checkpoint identity verification, subprocess lifecycle, timeouts and sequential GPU scheduling are needed for reproduction. Web references cannot establish these host-specific capabilities.

Differential agreement can preserve shared errors. Add independently constructed expected token/mapping fixtures, verify the selected live weights match the serialized checkpoint, and confirm observation hooks leave public predictor outputs unchanged.

Numerical acceptance criteria need explicit dtype/backend settings, finite-value checks and tolerances. Score agreement within tolerance does not guarantee identical top-10 membership near the ranking boundary.

Small candidate-score fixtures leave full-catalog unseen-item filtering, chunked scoring and final recommendation routing untested. Include bounded checks of the actual recommendation interface used for the twenty designated users.

Wrong-readout calibration needs unequal-padding fixtures: count-minus-one equals the correct index for full-length sequences. Wrong-route mutations need independently verified artifact misrouting, with loading failures reported separately from numerical discrepancies.

The workflow describes deletion/masking across three draws, while the cited measurements use matched substitutions across ten replicates. Identify the exact implementation and checkpoint behind each result before carrying conclusions forward.

Originality 4 is reasonable; potential 8 and difficulty 5 remain provisional without runner availability, measured overhead or a concrete integration. Bound the audit and define a stopping rule so it leaves budget for terminal-mask training experiments selected by pinned macro validation HR@10.
